user.title: Connect to opencodex
user.description: Enter the address of a reachable opencodex proxy. Its management API is intentionally unauthenticated, so use a trusted network or an external authenticated boundary.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach opencodex at that address. Is the proxy running, and has `ocx host enable` been run on it?
error.not_opencodex: Something answered, but it is not opencodex — check the port.
